TITLE: Tech View Group Header – Count Tooltip Opens Below the Number Instead of Above
TYPE: Story Defect · PARENT: SV-10045 (Tech View — table grouped by lead technician; Ready for QA, read live 16 Oct 2026 — re-read before the ask) · PRIORITY: Medium · LINK: relates to SV-10045
ALREADY REPORTED: none found among SV-11317 to SV-11326, SV-11338, SV-11393 to SV-11398 (titles read live 16 Oct 2026). SV-11322 is the display switcher's tooltip; SV-11395 is Board View's avatar bubble.
SEEN ON: staging build {{v26.40.18-7d85b7d}}, 16 Oct 2026 (run 498, C590117).
STATUS: DRAFT — NOT FILED. One ask per ticket; the QA lead decides (Rule 62/113).
NOTE: the placement "above the number" comes from the test case's Expected and the design picture; no PRD sentence names the tooltip's position (S2-R12 names only the count).

h2. Description

*Hovering the work order count in a Tech View technician group header should open a dark tooltip above the number.* On staging the tooltip opens below the number, over the group's first row.

For example,
* hovering the count "2" in a technician's group header shows "2 work orders"
* the tooltip sits under the number, on top of the first row of that group

h2. Steps to Reproduce

# Sign in to staging as an Admin, check the top bar shows *Staging Heavy Duty - 9919*, and use a browser window 1440 px wide at 100% zoom.
# Open *Work Orders*, click the *All* tab, then *Tech View* in the display switcher.
# Click the arrow on the *Unassigned* header to close it, so the technician groups come into view.
# Hover the number at the right of any technician's group header that has work orders.
#* "2 work orders" (or the group's count) shows in a grey tooltip.
#* The tooltip opens below the number, over the group's first row.

*Actual Result:*
* The count tooltip opens below the number.

*Expected Result:*
* As the test expects: *"Step 5: a dark tooltip opens above the number and does not cover any column header label."*
